hard_scope: Authored product-rule or quotient-rule derivatives of both parametric coordinates, followed by the same dy/dx ratio. Existing derivative-procedure and chain-rule prerequisites support the rule combinations; no tangent equation, second derivative, point inversion or new topic is added.
deduplication: Coordinate functions normalized by a common positive amplitude; relative amplitude, curve domain, evaluation target and reasoning workload remain. Seed, identity, bank and choice order do not create a question.
grading: Selected questions must accept canonical and mathematically equivalent entries and reject incorrect entries through the current learner grader. Legacy reports retain older native limits; current evidence supersedes those expectations where tested.
bounded_exceptions: Some unreduced radical or authored exponential/quotient forms in the frozen validation report have unresolved native comparisons. They are not asserted accepted; only verified entries and instances contribute to replenishment.
source_fidelity: All 18 practice prompts and solutions, 19 frozen complete banks, 67 values and 18 present correct designations replay. The current database removed one duplicate legacy field without a correct designation; the valid bank is unchanged.
